name: kakenhi-report
description: The kakenhi-report crew (ADR-092 slice 4): a JSPS-style (KAKENHI) outcome report. The lead establishes the baseline from the project's records (aims as funded, outcomes so far, what remains); writers draft the progress-to-date, the deliverables mapped to KAKEN categories and the future plan with milestones; a checker traces every outcome and reference; the lead fits the sections to the form's length. Read-only: the report comes back as the result.

subject.description: the funded project the report is for

context.description: the form's checklist, the grant number, what the records are

section_chars.description: the form's length limit per section, in characters

reviewer_model.description: a different model for the checker; the plan warns when it checks on the writer's model
